title: [PC, Steam] Hogwarts Legacy $8.99, Digital Deluxe Edition $9.99 @ Steam
body:
Deal: [PC, Steam] Hogwarts Legacy $8.99, Digital Deluxe Edition $9.99 @ Steam

[dav3] Unsure if this will every be free.
It was free on the Epic Store in December 2025
[dav3] ….. just like every other free game that I've claimed
[OZKap] Hey I played one game for 7 hours… Worth it
[darthsparrow] Claim it on Epig Game Store, buy it on Steam!
[The1Warden] It's wild I also claimed it for free and never installed it lmao
[Kinjiru] It promises much, and at first it is really cool, but then it gets super repetitive and grindy. I have 93 hours in it and haven't finished it because got too boring and repetitive.
[OZKap] It's a review without even a downvote of the post. Relax.
[LongJohn92] I'd agree. I still enjoyed it, but the last half of it had me flying straight to the main quests and I skipped the whole back half of the map.
[original15] Yeh I’m 30% of the way through and consider it repetitive. I’m a HP fan too
[SharkBait] The absolute uproar this caused amongst LGBT people upon release. Over a bloody video game, of all things… Still makes me laugh.
Anyway, as a Harry Potter game, it's pretty great. As a video game, it's fine. Probably wouldn't recommend to people who aren't already fans of that world though.
[Leeroy Jenkins] Can't bring myself to playing it. I played it a while back for an hour, found it quite boring. Have not had the drive to continue.
Game seems very uninspiring, Something about the presentation or the system was off-putting, but I can't pinpoint what exactly I don't like about it.
EDIT; I really don't know what it is, certain games just don't feel like they have a soul or character so to speak.
I played Demon's Souls back in 2009, and was instantly hooked. I played Final Fantasy Resonance demo, and didn't stop till 5 hours later. I played Resident Evil 2-4 Remake, and didn't touch any other game till I platinumed each one of them. Doesn't matter what genre it is, I just feel some games are filled with passion and love and I can feel it. Unfortunately to me, this is not one of them.
[Deviner] The first 2ish hours of this are probably the worst of any game I've ever played.
I immediately disliked it when I first played it a few years ago.
Went back to it to test out how it performed on a BC250, managed to survive the first couple hours, and actually liked it afterwards.
It is a little repetitive in the last third of the game, and the in game challenges can be very tedious.
Pretty decent though and still looks great.
[Rodderslee] So true all these modern games have no visual art style , they are focusing on realistic graphics with no style and every game ends up looking the same , just look at the batman arkham knight that game is over 10 years old and looks better than any modern release
[drift7rs] rowling very openly hates me and people like me for being Different (happening to be trans), but sure i guess, it’s just a game :/
